title: Antique Kodak No. 2A Brownie Model B Box Camera 116 Film c.1916 Eastman Kodak
condition_description: Untested antique, sold as a display/collector piece. Covering intact with corner wear and a few small chips; viewfinder glass cloudy; interior clean. Original owner's name and Los Angeles address scratched on the film insert.
description:
Eastman Kodak No. 2A Brownie Camera, Model B - antique box camera, U.S. patents Feb. 1, 1916 and Mar. 21, 1916. Takes No. 116 roll film. Made in U.S.A. by Eastman Kodak Company, Rochester, N.Y.

- Two reflex viewfinders (vertical and horizontal)
- Shutter lever, aperture and time/instant tabs on the side
- Brass film-advance key and latches, carrying-strap lugs
- Removable film insert with both spool clips; metal Eastman Kodak plate on the back
- Approx. 6 3/4 x 5 1/4 x 4 1/4 in

History: the film insert is scratched by hand "L. Snodgrass, 2416 ... St, L.A. Cal" - an original owner from Los Angeles.

Condition: untested, sold as-is as a display or collector piece. Black leatherette covering intact, with wear and small chips at the corners and edges and a small white scuff on one side. Viewfinder windows are cloudy with age. Interior and film chamber are clean; a few light specks on the pressure plate. No film, strap or box.
